catalog.summary: One dock icon for every Form app: switch, launch and arrange the family.

notes_for_owner: Not in formportal's products.json: the catalog entry is written from the README and tauri.conf.json. formtray is a Cargo workspace, so its bundles are under target/release/bundle at the repository root, not src-tauri/target; the artifact globs name those paths. No Tauri updater (no plugins.updater), so no latest.json. The old file's macos-x64 row used macos-13, which GitHub is retiring; macos-x64 here runs on macos-15-intel. The old file also uploaded build_app.log from each runner as a workflow artifact; it was never in the release's file list, so it is not released now. 'call build_app.bat' replaces the old bare 'build_app.bat' because formcompiler runs cmd lines from one script file and a bare .bat would end it. build_app makes the macOS disk image with hdiutil; formcompiler signs and notarizes it after the build (v0.6.0).
